gate_3_quality_and_saturation.rationale: HEL1OS HK counters (fehkstat, czt1satctr1, cdte1pilectr) lack bit definitions, saturation thresholds, and authorized rejection actions; SoLEXS RATE lacks quality column.

gate_4_product_version_compatibility.rationale: HEL1OS V111 vs V211 counterpart relationship is unadjudicated; SoLEXS cross-day product version compatibility is not documented.

gate_5_calibration_flux_compatibility.rationale: Both instruments provide raw count rates (counts/s, cts/sec); no audited L1 RATE-to-physical-flux conversion is available, whereas feature engineering pipeline requires physical flux.
